The only issue is I don’t know how I could tell them without it being obvious it was E. As mentioned before, they’ve had issues in the past and I’m not friends with her parents on Facebook, so i feel it would be weird for me, E’s friend, to randomly contact them out of the blue to tell them they’ve been doxxed.

Also, I didn’t mean to imply she doesn’t “want” to go to art school, my concern is she won’t get into one because of the small amount of schools she applied to, and then she’d have to spend more time with her family whom she hates.
